name: scos-fabric-tools
description: Claude Code and Claude Cowork plugins for connecting agents to the SCOS Memory Fabric

plugins.name: scos-memory-fabric
plugins.description: Connects Claude Code to the SCOS Memory Fabric's mcp-gateway (scos_recall, scos_status, scos_explain, scos_user_model, scos_memory_graph, scos_correct, scos_forget), with slash commands, a skill, and a SessionStart hook

plugins.name: scos-memory-fabric-cowork
plugins.description: Connects Claude Cowork to the SCOS Memory Fabric's mcp-gateway (scos_recall, scos_status, scos_explain, scos_user_model, scos_memory_graph, scos_correct, scos_forget) through a single scos-memory skill
